mechanism: Voriconazole is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that significantly reduces tolterodine metabolism, increasing tolterodine plasma concentrations and anticholinergic side effects.
action: Monitor closely for anticholinergic toxicity (urinary retention, constipation, cognitive effects, tachycardia) or consider dose reduction of tolterodine; alternative antifungal agents with less CYP3A4 inhibition may be preferred.
